description: The patch, digest and pinning updates Renovate merges wait for the pull request's checks: CI runs lint, the generate check, vet and the unit tests, and the image workflow builds the image for both architectures
schedule: before 12pm on the first day of the month

customManagers.description: Versions pinned in a Dockerfile ARG behind a '# renovate:' comment, such as the reference CNI plugins.

packageRules.description: client-go, apimachinery, api, controller-runtime and controller-tools must move together: each controller-runtime and controller-tools minor is built against one Kubernetes minor, and controller-gen generates the CRD and DeepCopy code for it.
Our own image is raised by hand as part of a release.
A new Go minor (the go directive and the golang image) waits for approval on the dashboard; patches flow as usual.
